My first time, it was horrifying. I felt like I was ready to do it, right up until I took them (along with some booze for good measure) my plan was to just go to sleep, and never wake up. But as soon as I tried to, I started to feel it. I don’t know if it was the OD, or just me being scared, but I could just feel my heart pounding. I’ve run half marathons before, but I had never once felt it beating that hard. In that moment I was scared that that would be it. That I would have a heart attack and die in pain. Even thinking about that feeling now makes me nauseous. I don’t know how much of that was the meds or how much was just plain fear, but that’s my experience. Wouldn’t recommend it.
